metadata.case_name: CHEUNG CHI WAH v. WAI LUEN METAL FACTORY

injuries.description: fracture of the middle phalanx of the 2nd toe
source: x-ray on 30th March 1992 which revealed fracture of the middle phalanx of the 2nd toe.
X-ray revealed the frature was completely healed.

manifestations.description: recurring pain once every now and then for a few minutes
tenderness over the flexor and extensor tendons
mildly swollen right 2nd toe with local tenderness

treatments_received: consultation with general practitioner Dr. Eddie T. Chan
orthopaedic outpatient consultation at Tuen Mun Hospital Department of Orthopaedics and Traumatology
consultation with Dr. Lau Hoi Kuen
consultation with Dr. Tsoi Chi Wah

losses.category: Loss of ability to engage in sports and hobbies
losses.description: Pain and suffering and loss of amenities claimed including inability to pursue hobbies (football, fishing, swimming).

comparable_cases.case_name: Wong Sam-mui (Administratrix of the Estate of Tam Wan Loong, deceased) v. Fan Yiu Sum
comparable_cases.injury_description: fractures to 2nd and 3rd metatarsal bones and lacerations, hospitalised for 3 weeks with follow up treatment for 6 months.

comparable_cases.case_name: Wong Hok Chuen v. Tai Kam Kui
comparable_cases.injury_description: concussion for a few hours, laceration of the scalp and the scrotum, a wedge fracture of the front of the body of the 2nd lumbar vertebra and some damage to the fifth lumbar nerve and to the right shoulder joint, hospitalized for 3 days.
